comments.author: X-N2O
comments.content: In order to decrypt the .data what you need is a decryption stub. The decryption stub is already there, but it needs to be called before the original entry point. This decryption stub is new_ep. We need to change the EP of the executable to the RVA of new_ep. That's what the NEW constant is. Next, after new_ep is done with decrypting, it should call/jump to the original EP. Hence we need to patch the placeholder (0x41414141) with the original EP VA. The REP constant contains the offset of the placeholder in the executable file.
